description: This Java source file defines the ServiceInvocationException class, a custom exception used to represent errors during remote service invocation, including error code handling and extraction of HTTP status codes.

classes.name: ServiceInvocationException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating an unexpected outcome of a remote service invocation, with error code validation and utility methods for error handling.

methods.name: ServiceInvocationException
methods.description: Constructs an exception with an error code, optionally with a message and cause, validating the error code range.

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the error code associated with the exception.

methods.name: providedOrDefaultMessage
methods.description: Provides a default message if none is supplied, based on the error code.

methods.name: extractStatusCode
methods.description: Static method to extract HTTP status code from a Throwable, returning 500 if not a ServiceInvocationException.
